findings.problem: Ten motion-only model exports explicitly return the full StudyModel union. That erases a family the producer already knows and makes their direct spec consumers add one-off runtime narrowing helpers before they can inspect motion or timeline. The other movement models already preserve MotionStudyModel.

evidence.detail: model is annotated StudyModel, while its only return starts with family: motion at line 179.
motionModel wraps the direct model import solely to check family and recover the motion subtype (lines 18–22).
viewOf repeats the same narrowing guard; the same pattern occurs in the other eight affected specs.
The same batch already uses the narrower MotionStudyModel return contract, as the existing Arrive/Seek/Wander models do.

producerConsumerPairs.consumer: study-models.ts / StudyModelModule (MotionStudyModel remains assignable to StudyModel)

findings.minimalFix: Import MotionStudyModel and use it as the return annotation in these ten modules. Their existing values already have that shape. Remove the now-redundant family-guard lines in the adjacent spec helpers where convenient; preserve useful default-parameter helpers. No registry or shared schema change is required.

findings.problem: The selected chart legend is reconstructed inside the composite, while StudyDrawingView.legend still carries the movement-body legend. This gives the mapped legend two meanings by family and duplicates legend rendering. Flow/marbles already resolve the selected legend in drawingOf, so the new motion-chart repair splits that responsibility across mapper and template.

evidence.detail: The new branch bypasses visual.legend and iterates visual.timeline.series; the else branch repeats the same paragraph/span loop over visual.legend (lines 76–93).
The shared drawing view uses model.legend; the motion branch changes view without replacing that legend (lines 39–59).
The existing flow branch already replaces the legend and caption for its selected marble diagram (lines 60–69).
The existing flow consumer contract explicitly expects switched.visual.legend to be the selected diagram legend.

producerConsumerPairs.consumer: study-mapper.spec.ts selected-diagram legend expectation and the same generic caption renderer

findings.minimalFix: Derive the selected motion legend from timeline.series in drawingOf when the resolved view is timeline, following the existing flow override. Render one legend loop in study.html and use an index or other key that remains unique when multiple series share a tone. The translated chart-guide paragraph can keep its small view conditional; no new schema or model abstraction is needed.
